response.text: There is a new user, RLOPEZ, who posted manual accruals in closed periods. I'll look at those, along with how many GL journals are in closed periods.

arguments.sql: SELECT h."SRC_REF", p."STAT_CD", COUNT(*), MIN(h."JRNL_NO"), MAX(h."JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."SRC_CD"='GL' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", p."STAT_CD", p."CLOSE_DT", h."SRC_REF" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (2430,2431,2432,2034,2386) ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) n, MIN("JRNL_NO") mn, MAX("JRNL_NO") mx FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_CD"='GL' AND h."JRNL_NO" > (SELECT MAX("JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='AP' AND "JRNL_NO"<2430)
